jobs.description:
**C++ / C# Developer**

**IT GMD Pricing Services Core is responsible for providing highly critical pricing and risk calculation facilities to a wide range of consumers within the bank ranging from the Front Office to a Regulatory Risk. Business users such as the risk quantitative analysts, FO and risk managers regularly interact with us to drive development.**

The sheer volume of daily data means we must consider innovative solutions to allow our compute and data storage capabilities to scale with the demands of increasing trade populations and regulatory-driven business requirements. Our tech stack is predominantly distributed .NET services, with relational and distributed databases, as well as a caching layer utilizing Couchbase.

Our calculations are being transitioned from IBM Symphony grid Manager to a new open-source grid Manager compatible with Cloud: ArmoniK.

The real time framework (Streaming / Contribution / flows / pre trade), for low latency constraints, is mainly implemented in C++.

Currently, we are investigating and actively implementing solutions involving burst into cloud and cloud-native services.

We are looking for highly skilled individuals to help implement, extend and support our computing middleware systems including the review of the real time framework, grid and cloud oriented components and contribute to the project roadmap and architectural governance.

**Requirements Mandatory:**

* Developing services using C++/ C#/.Net Core.
* Proven aptitude for design, producing, and tuning code.
* Skills in parallel algorithms for multi-core architectures.
* Strong knowledge of real-time software development in C++, ideally in electronic markets.
* Proven experience in profiling, monitoring, optimization and production support in real-time distributed systems.
* Clear understanding of multithreaded systems.
* Autonomy. Excellent communication skills.
* Interest in latest technologies and software development practices.
* Basic experience in pricing and market making are desirable.

**Desirable Requirements:**

* Static, dynamic and web analysis tools (e.g. CheckMarx, SonarQube, OWASP Zap, Clair Container).
* Serverless architecture and cloud agnostic tools.
* GitLab, JIRA, and lifecycle/continuous integration tools (Jenkins, Artifactory, Ansible).
* Stream processing tools (Kafka, Spark).
* Performance analysis, instrumentation and visualization tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Kiali).
* Managing Linux servers\VMs.
* Deploying and managing Kubernetes clusters.

**Développeur C++ / C#**

IT GMD Pricing Services Core est responsable de la fourniture de fonctionnalités hautement critiques de calcul des prix et des risques à un large éventail d'utilisateurs au sein de la banque, allant du Front Office aux équipes de risque réglementaire. Les utilisateurs métier, tels que les analystes quantitatifs en gestion des risques ainsi que les responsables du Front Office et des risques, interagissent régulièrement avec nous afin de piloter les développements.

Le volume considérable de données quotidiennes nous impose d'envisager des solutions innovantes permettant à nos capacités de calcul et de stockage des données d'évoluer en fonction de l'augmentation du nombre de transactions et des exigences métier liées à la réglementation. Notre environnement technologique repose principalement sur des services .NET distribués, des bases de données relationnelles et distribuées, ainsi qu'une couche de mise en cache utilisant Couchbase.

Nos calculs sont en cours de migration du gestionnaire de grille IBM Symphony vers un nouveau gestionnaire de grille open source compatible avec le cloud : ArmoniK.

Le framework temps réel — streaming, contributions, flux et pré-trade — est principalement développé en C++ afin de répondre aux contraintes de faible latence.

Nous étudions et mettons actuellement en œuvre des solutions impliquant une capacité de montée en charge ponctuelle dans le cloud ainsi que des services cloud natifs.

Nous recherchons des profils hautement qualifiés pour contribuer à l'implémentation, à l'évolution et au support de nos systèmes de middleware de calcul, notamment à la revue du framework temps réel et des composants orientés grille et cloud, ainsi qu'à la feuille de route du projet et à la gouvernance de l'architecture.

**Exigences obligatoires :**

* Développement de services en C++ / C# / .NET Core.
* Aptitude démontrée à concevoir, produire et optimiser du code.
* Compétences en algorithmes parallèles pour architectures multicœurs.
* Solide connaissance du développement de logiciels temps réel en C++, idéalement dans le domaine des marchés électroniques.
* Expérience confirmée en profilage, supervision, optimisation et support de production de systèmes distribués temps réel.
* Bonne compréhension des systèmes multithread.
* Autonomie et excellentes compétences en communication.
* Intérêt pour les technologies récentes et les bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel.
* Une première expérience en pricing et en market making serait un atout.

**Exigences souhaitables :**

* Outils d'analyse statique, dynamique et web, par exemple Checkmarx, SonarQube, OWASP ZAP et Clair Container.
* Architecture serverless et outils indépendants du cloud.
* GitLab, JIRA et outils de gestion du cycle de vie / d'intégration continue, tels que Jenkins, Artifactory et Ansible.
* Outils de traitement de flux, tels que Kafka et Spark.
* Outils d'analyse, d'instrumentation et de visualisation des performances, tels que Prometheus, Grafana et Kiali.
* Administration de serveurs Linux et de machines virtuelles.
* Déploiement et administration de clusters Kubernetes.

**The position at a glance**

The RISK function supports BNP Paribas's mission by maintaining a robust risk management culture based on a long-term perspective and committed management. Req ID:531041

  

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. Are you passionate about the railway world and complex systems? The Train Control & Monitoring Systems (TCMS) team opens its doors to you (**St-Bruno office, QC**).

The Train Control and Monitoring System (TCMS) team is involved in the improvement and troubleshooting of our customers active train fleets. The typical projects span from issue troubleshooting, obsolescence management to functional improvements.

The TCMS has an onboard and a wayside application: The onboard portion acquires train data, apply control rules and activates outputs for train operation. It also gathers multiple train health metrics that are sent to the wayside software over wireless links. The wayside application receives, processes, archives and makes this data available for consultation. This data is used for efficient train operation, preventive and reactive maintenance.

The team needs to increase its capacity into a distributed system with multi Operating Systems and programming languages environment, articulated through Network protocols, to fulfil our customers projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

As an **onboard Software developer**, you will be responsible for the maintenance and improvement of the various software components as well as being a key player in the related design and troubleshooting of train software and build process tools.

The Software developer works in close relationship with the Software Testers and System Engineers towards the delivery of a reliable and issue free software in compliance with established processes in a continuous build, integration and delivery fashion.

  

You are responsible to:

* Analyse data to define and validate technical solutions.
* Implement software solutions corresponding to client requirements.
* Troubleshoot, debug and assess onboard existing issues.
* Maintain and improve software development ecosystem (coding, configuration management, continuous integration, test tools, etc…)
* Participate in the entire software development lifecycle (analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance).
* Write technical reports that comply with company standards.

  

**Your profile**

You will have a demonstrable knowledge and capability across a range of different computer operating systems, medium-high software programming and network knowledge.

Candidate must be versatile, resourceful, autonomous and handy at intervening on existing SW components.

  

**Profile & Technical Skills**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or equivalent.
* **3–5 years** of experience in embedded software development.
* Strong programming skills in **C, C++, C#**.
* Good knowledge of scripting/programming languages such as **Python, Bash/Shell scripting, and PowerShell**.
* Experience with **RTOS and** **embedded Linux**.
* Comfortable working in both **Windows** and **Linux** development environments.
* Good understanding of **embedded systems**, **multithreading**, **memory management**, **inter-process communication**, and r**eal-time constraints**.
* Knowledge of communication protocols and interfaces such as **Ethernet, TCP/IP, UDP, CAN, UART, SPI, and I²C**.
* Experience with **Git** or any other source control, **branching**, and **code review** practices.
* Familiarity with build systems and toolchains such as **CMake**, **Make**, **GCC**, and **cross-compilation**.
* Experience with **debugging** (analyzing engineering log, Wireshark, etc), **unit testing**, and **integration testing**.
* Familiarity with **CI/CD** (Git piplines, jenkin jobs, …) and automated build/test environments.
* Knowledge of **object-oriented programming**, **software architecture**, and design principles.
* Ability to analyze **software requirements** and produce clear technical documentation.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.

  

**What you will enjoy in this role and working at ALSTOM**

* Working daily in an innovative project environment
* Receiving a competitive salary including full social coverage (life, health, retirement) from the start of employment
* Developing new skills and your full potential through the continuous training offered

HNA S.E.N.C.R.L. est un cabinet comptable multidisciplinaire figurant parmi les 20 plus grands joueurs au Québec. * Assurances collectives modulaires;
* Formation continue;
* Accompagnement de développement de carrière personnalisé;

Il prend en charge les demandes de soutien, résout les problématiques rencontrées et veille à l’installation, à la configuration et à l’entretien des équipements et outils informatiques.

* Autonomie, débrouillardise et agilité.
* Capacité à gérer plusieurs demandes, des priorités changeantes et des délais serrés.
* Bonne connaissance des systèmes d’exploitation Windows, de Microsoft 365 et des différentes composantes des réseaux locaux d’entreprise.
* Bonne maîtrise du français parlé et écrit.
* Capacité à lire, comprendre et communiquer en anglais lorsque requis (documentation technique, outils et fournisseurs).

**We are looking for a reliable and technically skilled Desktop Support Engineer to provide on-demand, on-site** IT support for enterprise clients. This role involves responding to service requests when required and providing hands-on technical assistance for desktop systems, laptops, network connectivity, and peripheral devices at the client location.

* Provide on-site desktop and IT support for end users at the client location.

* Experience in hardware troubleshooting and replacement

* Windows Laptop

* Basic IT troubleshooting tools

**Work Model**

* On-demand / field support role

* Engineers will be contacted via phone or email when support is required
* Engineers will receive site location, SPOC details, and reporting time before each assignment
* No guaranteed number of working hours
